title: GENIUS Act Monthly Reserve Attestation & Disclosure Requirements Checklist
description: Generates a monthly reserve attestation and disclosure compliance checklist for permitted payment stablecoin issuers (PPSIs) per GENIUS Act §6. Covers the 1:1 reserve requirement, eligible asset composition, PCAOB-registered accounting firm examination obligations, public disclosure format, redemption policy publication, and the 15-business-day cure window for reserve shortfalls.

outstanding_usd.description: Total outstanding stablecoins in USD for the disclosure period

reserves_total_usd.description: Total reserve assets held in USD

monthly_report_posted.description: Monthly reserve report posted to website this period

cure_window_active.description: Whether a reserve shortfall cure window is currently active

cure_days_elapsed.description: Business days elapsed since shortfall identified (maximum 15 under §6(d))

segregated.description: Asset segregation from corporate funds maintained

surplus_usd.description: Reserve surplus (positive) or shortfall (negative) in USD

disclosure_checklist.description: 14-item monthly disclosure checklist with pass/fail status

cure_window.description: Cure window status if shortfall detected
